description: A page driven by script rather than CSS: a green dot moved by requestAnimationFrame from performance.now(), and a counter bumped by setInterval every 100 ms, in the shipped Inter. Both run on the clock the capture owns, so at frame 15 (0.5 s) the counter reads 5 and the dot is 700 CSS px along, and at frame 29 it reads 9. A counter ahead or behind means timers fired on the wall clock; a dot that never moves means rAF was not called.
